lastCompletedStory.title: Convert the 4 writers to the file-per-issue dir

nextStoryContext: US-004 complete. All 4 writers (issue-file, issue-specify, triage, ship-finalize) now read/write scripts/cam/issues/CAM-NNNN.json exclusively via the per-file primitives (writeIssueFile, readBacklogFromMain, issueFilePath). issues.local.json is never touched by any writer. The key integration tests were updated from the old array-format (issues.local.json) to the new per-file format (CAM-NNNN.json). index.ts _buildFinalizeOpts uses issueFilePath for both readIssues and writeIssues. Full suite: 2033 pass, 0 fail.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-004 only modified existing internal modules (git plumbing via injectable SpawnFn, readBacklogFromMain, issueFilePath). No external npm library was introduced.
